_about: Titan overlay, deep-merged over data/tuning.json (src/gameData.ts, rules/merge.ts). Keys starting with _ are notes and are dropped; null removes a shared key. Sections not listed here are the Moon's. Types: rules/types.ts Tuning, rules/titanTypes.ts, rules/marsTypes.ts (sol, night).
_placeholder: Values in a section with a _placeholder note are stubs for the track named there. Values under _interface are set with Owner A. Titan reuses the Moon parts and ticket tiers (no Titan parts).

mission._note: Decided: one Titan day in 15 minutes (sol.sols x sol.secondsPerSol = lengthSeconds). gameDays counts Titan days. gravity: Titan surface gravity, m/s^2 (to fact-check, R).

payout._interface: survivalPayout: Titan survival payout, Owner A sets it (placeholder: the Moon value). The Titan final mark is budget.minimumBudget.complete in data/tuning.json (placeholder 0: a Titan round fails only if the balance goes negative; T4 and Owner A decide the final mark).

rover._placeholder: Integration (T6) tunes on the real terrain. gravityScale keeps the ground gravity the Moon's handling was tuned for (1.35 x 4.8 = 6.48 m/s^2, the Moon's 1.62 x 4); airGravityScale stays the time-lapse value (16 x the world's gravity).

sun._placeholder: Fallback only, until rules (T3) give the real Titan Sun and integration (T6) wires it: the lunar Sun model fixed near noon at the placeholder site (subsolar longitude = site longitude).

cold._note: No cold zones on Titan: the cold is map-wide and always on (titanCold, rules track T3).

sol._placeholder: Rules (T3) decide whether Titan reuses the sol clock (rules/sol.ts). Decided design: one day of 900 s, 450 s day then 450 s night, the mission starts 150 s after sunrise and ends 150 s after the next dawn. solarLongitudeDeg: Saturn's season at the site in 2034 (northern winter, to fact-check, R).

night._placeholder: Rules (T3) tune against the Moon batteries (400, 600) in titanEnergy.test.ts. The Mars night rules: lights on to drive, awake without lights, or sleep. freezeRatePerSecond and warmRecoveryPerSecond are unused on Titan (the cold is titanCold).

sleep._placeholder: Rules (T3). Proposed design: asleep at night, the clock runs 4x faster.

titanPower._placeholder: Rules (T3). Solar income = the Moon panel rate x solarFactor by day (effectively zero).

titanCold._placeholder: Rules (T3). Always-on cold: base freeze rate everywhere; the heater (tuning.cold.heaterReductionPerHeat x heat) and the electronics while awake (awakeHeat, plus drivingHeat while driving) slow it; asleep only the heater does.

look._placeholder: Sky and light (T2): colors as hex strings, fog densities, light intensities, shadow softness, rain fog. Types: rules/titanTypes.ts TitanLookTuning.

survey._placeholder: Milestones and survey (T5). Orbital survey leads: the Selk ejecta field (rockyAreas.0). Text in data/titan/text.json survey.leads. Rounding is the Moon's.

milestones._placeholder: Milestones and survey (T5): Titan zone sizes and actions (rules/titanTypes.ts TitanMilestoneTuning).
